intro.title: Your passwords, on your server
intro.text: End-to-end encrypted: only your devices can read them – not the server, not an administrator. Works offline and syncs without the VPN.

setup.title: Set up Vault
setup.pwText: It opens your vault on all devices. It never leaves this device – not even the GateControl server knows it.
setup.pwRule: At least 12 characters and not weak – a few random words work well.
setup.warnText: Not even an administrator. In the next step you get a recovery key – without it, your data is lost if you forget the password.
setup.doneText: Choose how you open Vault on this PC.

recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.text: With it you get into your vault if you forget the master password. It is shown only this once.
recovery.tip1: Print it and keep it with your important papers.
recovery.tip2: Do not keep it as a photo or file in the cloud.
recovery.tip3: You can also name trusted people for emergency access later.
recovery.confirm: I have kept the key safe
recovery.printNote: Keep this page safe. Anyone who has this key and your vault can read it. Created {{ date }}.
recovery.label: Recovery key

remember.title: Stay signed in
remember.text: Vault opens under your Windows account without the master password (protected by Windows). The master password is not stored.

quickInfo.title: Quick search
quickInfo.text: Press Ctrl+Alt+P to find passwords from any program.

recover.title: Recover access
recover.text: Enter your recovery key. Then choose a new master password – you also get a new recovery key.
recover.typo: Typo? The key has 56 characters in 14 groups – check them once more.
recover.newPwText: Choose a new master password. The old recovery key no longer works afterwards.
